g.text: Live refresh — editor save -> painted DOM (one full round trip)
INVARIANT: content cache changes; UI/navigation state is untouched
content-flight: ONE read of the path, numbered seq n
(a read already running → marked dirty → one trailing read)
deliver! → webContents.send to EVERY retaining window
ordering guard: seq n ≤ the applied :doc/seq → drop it WHOLE
and history are in app-db — NOT touched by any
:ds/* transaction, so they survive the refresh.
IPC seam (preload, contextBridge) — all amber arrows
